# Pranshu Rastogi — Blockchain Engineer, Speaker & Web3 Builder

## About
Pranshu Rastogi is the Head of Ecosystem & Integrations at Push Chain (formerly Push Protocol). He is a blockchain engineer with 7+ years of experience building in Web3, a speaker at 30+ global conferences, and a technical writer on Medium. Find him on X at @pranshurastogii and on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/rastogipranshu.

## Current Role
- **Position:** Head of Ecosystem & Integrations
- **Company:** Push Chain (push.org)
- **Focus:** Ecosystem growth, strategic partnerships, developer adoption, decentralized communication infrastructure

## Career History
- **Push Chain / Push Protocol** (Nov 2021 – Present): VP of Engineering, then Head of Ecosystem. Led engineering org, scaled protocol to 1,000+ integrations, shipped core notification system.
- **Dhiway** (Aug 2020 – Sep 2021): Software Engineer. Built decentralized identity solutions on Substrate chains, DID protocols, verifiable credentials.
- **Terse Software** (Apr 2019 – Jul 2020): Software Engineer. Architected backend systems and wrote first production smart contracts.

## Notable Projects

### SPECTER (specterpq.com)
Post-quantum stealth address protocol for Ethereum and Sui. Uses ML-KEM-768 (NIST FIPS 203) for quantum-resistant private payments via ENS/SuiNS names. Every payment goes to a fresh one-time stealth address — the sender and recipient stay completely private onchain. Integrates with Yellow Network for private off-chain trading. Research and insights: https://specterpq.com/insights

### VANTA (github.com/pranshurastogi/VANTA)
A transaction firewall that sits between AI agents and the blockchain. Every proposed transaction is scored through a policy engine and AI risk scanner before it can execute. No prompt injection, no urgency signal, and no model error can bypass the gate — only tiered human confirmation can. VANTA makes AI-powered blockchain interactions safe by default, preventing autonomous agents from draining wallets or triggering irreversible on-chain actions.

### AlphIQ (alphiq.xyz)
All-in-one Alephium blockchain analytics dashboard with real-time network stats, wallet profiling, Ralph contract decoder, gamified quests, and XP-powered achievements.

### EYI — Earn Your Identity
Decentralized identity verification platform. Connect ENS, GitHub, X, and Farcaster to build a verified, privacy-respecting Web3 identity with risk assessment and fraud detection.

### Bloom Ideas
Collaborative idea-sharing platform built on Etherlink. Users plant ideas, grow them via community engagement, and earn NFT rewards.

### Intellilearn
Gamified Web3 education platform that transforms blockchain learning into epic quests with decentralized identity and XP rewards.
